name: Grizzly Bear
description: A grizzly bear is a large, formidable predator known for its strength and aggressiveness, especially when provoked or defending its territory. It has a distinctive humped shoulder profile and dense brown fur, and is found in forested and mountainous regions.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: he grizzly bear uses its powerful front paws to deliver a massive swipe, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Territorial Roar
actions.description: In response to a creature moving within 10 units of the grizzly bear, it makes an intimidating roar against them. The targeted creature must make a resilience check of 6 or higher or their move speed becomes 0 until the end of their turn. On a success, a creature cannot be affected by this ability again.

actions.name: Wild Ravage
actions.description: The grizzly bear enhances their next Maul action by lowering the attack check by 1d4 but causing any hit to be upgraded to a true hit.

traits.name: Territorial
traits.description: The grizzly bear gains a 1d4 bonus to resistance and resilience checks while inside it's lair.
